scope: Public-safe environment record for the 650-request ACA run whose metrics are in this directory. Values are read from the operator's management-plane readbacks and the client VM's own records; identifiers that would name the subscription, resource group, hostnames or addresses are omitted.

client.role: Load generator: runs gateway-cache/aca_cache_matrix.py, which imports the measured coding-matrix/claude_api.py and bench.py unchanged
client.compute: Azure VM Standard_D4s_v5, East US 2; the same VM that ran the 2026-10-26 direct coding matrix
client.runner_sha256_scope: gateway-cache/aca_cache_matrix.py as copied to the VM before the run; the published file may differ only by later public edits recorded in Git
client.credential: Gateway key read from a mode-600 file on the VM; the client never holds a Foundry credential

gateway.service: Azure Container Apps, East US 2, Consumption workload profile
gateway.revision: one revision in Single revision mode, 1 replica (min 1, max 1), 2 vCPU, 4 GiB memory, 8 GiB ephemeral storage
gateway.image_digest_scope: Digest of the built image in the operator's private registry; the registry name is omitted. Rebuilding deploy/Dockerfile produces a different digest
gateway.configuration: deploy/config.yaml: drop_params false, zero LiteLLM and router retries, Entra token refresh on, user-assigned managed identity for Foundry
gateway.ingress: External HTTPS only (allowInsecure false, target port 4000) with three /32 allow rules; the addresses are omitted

target.service: Microsoft Foundry resource, East US 2; Claude Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5 and Haiku 5.5, model version 2, GlobalStandard
target.inference_placement: Responses reported inference_geo global and an East US 2 served-region header; GlobalStandard does not fix the inference region

run.resumed_utc: 2026-10-27T03:52:06Z and 2026-10-27T08:29:00Z after operator-initiated stop/start of the client VM
run.tcp_connect_scope: Median of 10 TCP connects from the client VM to the gateway at each preflight; the last value is the one recorded in run.json
run.restart_effect: Two measured pairs crossed the stop/restart gap and rewrote expired cache entries; they stay in request, cost and correctness counts and are excluded only from cache-hit statistics

verification.method: Operator readbacks (az containerapp show, az containerapp env show), the VM-side run receipt and runner sync log, the image build log, and the post-grading package inventory in ../gateway-score-20261027/environment.json (httpx 0.28.1, azure-identity 1.25.1 on the same VM)
verification.not_captured: No in-run telemetry of CPU, memory or replica restarts on the gateway; no packet capture; the gateway's own request log for this batch was not retained, which is the outbound-audit gap stated on the results page
